description: Public sewer under an extension; build-over agreement; fee earner to raise an enquiry.

segments.text: The drainage search shows a public sewer running under the extension at the back of the property.
What does that mean for us?
We need a build-over agreement from the water company, or confirmation that one was granted when the extension was built.
I don't think the sellers mentioned one.
I'll raise an enquiry with the sellers' solicitors today and ask for a copy. If there isn't one, we'll need to apply, and that usually takes about four weeks.
Do I need to do anything?
